attempts.summary: Created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (RSA 4096, self-signed, CA:TRUE, CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison) on node1 (RHEL 7.9), installed it into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and ran update-ca-trust extract, confirmed it's trusted via trust list and openssl verify, and proved end-to-end trust by signing and verifying a leaf certificate. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native shutdown -r now reboot with a returned acknowledgement, polled until exec access returned, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA trust state persisted post-restart.
